description: Risk Register for Unified Engineering Agents System
methodology: Risks scored by Impact (1-5) × Likelihood (1-5) = Risk Score (1-25). Threshold: ≥15 = High, 8-14 = Medium, ≤7 = Low.

risks.title: EAS v2 LocalSubstrateAdapter unavailable on Windows
risks.description: EAS v2 sandbox uses Linux namespaces, seccomp, pivot_root which are not available on Windows. WindowsExecutor uses Job Objects (partial isolation). This creates platform parity gap.
risks.mitigation: Develop WindowsExecutorAdapter first (current platform). Test Linux substrate in CI via WSL2/GitHub Actions. Document isolation differences clearly. Fail-closed on Windows for operations requiring full isolation.

risks.title: Grant system HMAC key management in production
risks.description: Grants require HMAC-SHA256 signing. Key rotation, storage, and distribution in multi-machine deployments is complex. Compromise = full authorization bypass.
risks.mitigation: Use HSM or cloud KMS for key storage. Implement key rotation schedule (90 days). Audit log all grant validations. Use short grant TTLs (max 24h).

risks.title: LLM provider API changes breaking adapters
risks.description: 6 LLM providers (NVIDIA, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, Custom) each with own API. Providers frequently change endpoints, models, parameters.
risks.mitigation: Abstract provider interface (UnifiedLLMClient). Version-pin provider SDKs. Integration tests per provider in CI. Feature flags for new models. Fallback to Ollama local.

risks.title: Token budget exhaustion causing mission failure
risks.description: Complex missions can exceed token budgets. Fail-closed behavior aborts mission. No partial credit for work done.
risks.mitigation: TokenBudget with per-agent, per-mission, per-project scopes. Warning at 70%, throttle at 90%, hard stop at 100%. Budget estimation in Planner. Checkpoint resume preserves work.

risks.title: Review cycle infinite loops (AgentFactory: no max, EAS: max 3)
risks.description: AgentFactory had no review cycle limit. EAS v2 enforces max 3. Unified system must enforce limit to prevent infinite REVISE→PLANNING loops.
risks.mitigation: State machine enforces max 3 review cycles. After 3 REVISE→PLANNING, Arbiter called automatically. Sub-verdict STAGNANT triggers escalation.

risks.title: Verification false positives (claiming EVIDENCED without evidence)
risks.description: Verifier might pass criteria without mechanical checks. Agent claims 'done' without file creation. Hash mismatches ignored.
risks.mitigation: VerificationStandard mandates mechanical checks only. Verifier implementation is deterministic (no LLM). Evidence chain: artifact → sha256 → EvidenceRecord → Verification. Unit tests for each CriterionType.

risks.title: Arbiter decision quality - same conflict fingerprint detection
risks.description: Arbiter must detect STAGNANT (same conflict fingerprint). False negative = infinite retry. False positive = premature escalation.
risks.mitigation: Arbiter input includes failure fingerprint (error class, tool, stage). Track retry count per fingerprint. Max 3 Arbiter calls before forced escalation. Human review of Arbiter decisions.

risks.title: Sandbox image supply chain security
risks.description: Sandbox uses container images. Malicious image = code execution. Images must be from allowlist with verified digests.
risks.mitigation: Image allowlist with pinned digests (sha256). No :latest tags. Image scan in CI. SBOM generation. Runtime attestation (future).

risks.title: Checkpoint corruption or loss preventing resume
risks.description: Checkpoints enable resume. Corruption or loss = mission restart from scratch. State includes task graph, artifact refs, evidence hashes.
risks.mitigation: Checkpoint has sha256 integrity hash. Multiple checkpoints per run. Atomic write (temp + rename). Replicate to durable storage. Validate on load.

risks.title: Event bus overflow / memory pressure
risks.description: In-process EventBus can accumulate unlimited events for long missions. Memory pressure on long-running missions.
risks.mitigation: Event store persistence with in-memory buffer (max 10k events). Configurable retention. Background flush to disk. WebSocket streams recent events only.

risks.title: Human approval gate bottleneck
risks.description: AWAITING_APPROVAL requires human. No human = mission stalls. Dashboard/CLI must be available.
risks.mitigation: CLI approval command for headless. Webhook/callback for automation. Configurable timeout → auto-escalate or auto-abort. Multiple human reviewers.

risks.title: AgentFactory and EAS v2 state machine divergence
risks.description: Two systems with 13 states each but different semantics. Unification must not lose guarantees (EAS v2: evidence-based, AgentFactory: UI-friendly).
risks.mitigation: Unified state machine in state_machine.py with explicit transition table. Validation function rejects invalid transitions. Golden rule (VERIFIED=user only) enforced in code. Tests for all transitions.

risks.title: No host execution fallback for sandbox
risks.description: EAS v2: LocalSubstrateAdapter unavailable = hard fail. No host fallback. WindowsExecutor partial only. Some operations may be impossible on Windows.
risks.mitigation: Document Windows limitations clearly. CI runs on Linux for full isolation tests. Windows users use WSL2 for full features. Graceful degradation for non-critical operations.

risks.title: Agent role protocol mismatch between systems
risks.description: AgentFactory: 8 agents with factory functions. EAS v2: 5 roles (Thinker, Reviewer, Implementer, Verifier, Arbiter) as classes. Unified protocol must cover both.
risks.mitigation: AgentRole protocol in agent_contract.py covers all 8 types. Factory functions create protocol-compliant agents. Role classes implement protocol. Adapter for EAS v2 roles.

risks.title: WebSocket port 8768 conflicts
risks.description: AgentFactory dashboard uses ws://127.0.0.1:8768. Conflicts if multiple instances or stale processes.
risks.mitigation: Port detection at startup. Auto-kill stale python processes. Configurable port via env var. Health check endpoint.

review_schedule: Weekly during active development, monthly after stabilization
